lines.text: Moses gathers Israel and says the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest, with no fire lit in any dwelling.
Moses tells everyone with a willing heart to bring gold, silver, and bronze, and tells every skilled craftsman to come and make everything.
Men and women with willing hearts bring gold rings and necklaces, and the judges bring onyx stones and gemstones for the ephod.
Moses says the LORD has called Bezalel of the tribe of Judah and given him and Oholiab of the tribe of Levi the ability to teach others.
The people keep bringing freewill offerings morning after morning until the craftsmen tell Moses they have more than enough, and a proclamation stops further giving.
